signature: SUBROUTINE DSYTRF_AA( UPLO, N, A, LDA, IPIV, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: IPIV
params.workDependent: where pivot candidates tie exactly, which one is chosen depends on the rounding of the block size LWORK selects, in the reference as in the JS

overrides.reason: DSYTRF_AA shrinks its block size from LWORK (NB = (LWORK-N)/N when LWORK < (1+NB)*N). The blocked and the block-size-1 runs round differently, and where two pivot candidates tie exactly in magnitude (the module's integer-valued 40x40 test matrices), the rounding decides which IDAMAX picks: the reference itself returns IPIV(13) = 18 with LWORK = 5000 and 39 with LWORK = 2*N on that matrix (checked by compiling the reference), as the JS does. The factor A agrees to rounding; the module's tests check the factor at the minimum WORK against the optimum (ticket 0100).
